name: Harrow's Journeyman
blurb: Harrow's apprentice, Relic-Bearer of the Runestaff, Act Two's Ironspire: a young dwarf more forge than man now, wild-haired, masked, eyes catching the light, in a shaggy fur mantle and a ragged plum cloak marked with brass runes, a leather jerkin, belt and pouches, bound sleeves and buckled boots, and the Runestaff with its burning compass-star. Every part moves whole on its own joint, so nothing stretches.
